blocks.content: The online manual for the T-38N / F-5B Professional is being written. Its sections are listed above and fill in as they're finished.

blocks.title: The full manual is in the cockpit
blocks.content: Until this manual is complete, use the one in the aircraft's EFB, under the Aircraft tab.

blocks.title: Simulation use only
blocks.content: This manual is written for Microsoft Flight Simulator. Don't use it for real-world flight.
